name: Marginal action value
structure: Evaluate whether an additional action changes attainable victory or survival.
acceptance: Reject redundant payoff only after checking relevant rival threats.
novelty: Related strategic abstractions; not independent discoveries.

name: Output bias
structure: Separate impressive visible resource growth from useful progress.
acceptance: Avoid equating bigger board or hand with higher win probability.
novelty: Related strategic abstractions; not independent discoveries.

name: Train intuitive choices
structure: Use postgame comparison to improve rapid decision recognition.
acceptance: Record failed intuitive choices and successful exceptions; no claim of universal heuristics.
novelty: Related strategic abstractions; not independent discoveries.

name: Finite utilization budget
structure: Compare drawn cards and developed assets with capacity to use them before the game ends.
acceptance: Nine-turn and fourteen-card figures are unverified illustrative assumptions.
novelty: Related strategic abstractions; not independent discoveries.

name: Two-player objective alignment
structure: Assess own progress and rival access to winning routes together.
acceptance: Include opponent independent objectives and legal choices.
novelty: Related strategic abstractions; not independent discoveries.

name: Opposing response cost
structure: Estimate which responses a credible threat requires and what each consumes.
acceptance: Use actual costs and legal response windows; no invented exact hand.
novelty: Related strategic abstractions; not independent discoveries.

name: Competing expenditure
structure: Compare rival response cost with their ability to make a second consequential play.
acceptance: Separate resource types, timing and alternative funding.
novelty: Related strategic abstractions; not independent discoveries.

name: Reactive role induction
structure: Create a threat that can redirect rival resources away from preferred development.
acceptance: Opponent may decline to react; include consequences if ignored.
novelty: Related strategic abstractions; not independent discoveries.

name: Unspent opposing capacity
structure: Compare entering a contest with delaying exposure when a rival has response capacity.
acceptance: Unused energy may have other applications; check scoring cost of waiting.
novelty: Related strategic abstractions; not independent discoveries.

name: Punishment-set comparison
structure: Compare candidate lines by classes of legal answers and follow-up options.
acceptance: No probabilities from counting named answers without deck/hand evidence.
novelty: Related strategic abstractions; not independent discoveries.

name: Maximum output versus resilience
structure: Compare favorable-case development with loss under credible response combinations.
acceptance: Include failure state and alternative actions; no deterministic best line.
novelty: Related strategic abstractions; not independent discoveries.

name: Escalating rescue commitment
structure: Reassess after initial threat fails rather than automatically spending protection and support.
acceptance: Earlier investment is sunk; preserve feasible future plan.
novelty: Related strategic abstractions; not independent discoveries.

name: Equipment exposure choice
structure: Compare equipped and unequipped states and where resources remain.
acceptance: Verify actual attachment and payment; equipment may be removed.
novelty: Related strategic abstractions; not independent discoveries.

name: Deferred scoring as development
structure: Compare accepting zero immediate points with retaining later board capacity.
acceptance: Reject if opponent can reach decisive score before conversion.
novelty: Related strategic abstractions; not independent discoveries.

name: Threat persistence in reserve
structure: Develop a credible later contest while preserving multiple future placements or support options.
acceptance: Verify position, readiness and legal timing; rival can attack another route.
novelty: Related strategic abstractions; not independent discoveries.

name: Response-combination burden
structure: Evaluate whether opposing answers must be combined at cost of development.
acceptance: Do not infer inability to act from incomplete hand or rules.
novelty: Related strategic abstractions; not independent discoveries.

name: Represented interaction
structure: Account for plausible hidden options signaled by retained resources.
acceptance: Distinguish actual card, common inclusion and theoretical possibility; no perfect information.
novelty: Related strategic abstractions; not independent discoveries.

name: Practice outside tournament clock
structure: Explore counterfactual branches after games to improve reasonable-paced decisions.
acceptance: No unauthorized pauses, rewinds or slow play.
novelty: Related strategic abstractions; not independent discoveries.
